front: Distance of $x$ to the hyperplane $f(x)=\langle w,x\rangle+b=0$

back: Scale so the closest point has $yf(x)=1$; all points satisfy $yf(x)\ge1$ and the margin is $1/\|w\|$.
0: correct and outside margin; $(0,1]$: inside the margin, correct; $>1$: misclassified. $\sum\xi$ bounds the number of errors.
$\max\{0,1-y f(x)\}$: zero beyond the margin, linear inside; convex upper bound of the 0-1 loss.
$\tfrac12\|w\|^2+C\sum_n\max\{0,1-y_nf(x_n)\}$: the margin term is the regulariser.

front: Stationarity conditions of the SVM Lagrangian

back: Training points with $\alpha_n>0$: on the margin ($0<\alpha<C$) or inside/violating it ($\alpha=C$). The others do not affect $w$.
From a margin support vector: $b=y_n-\langle w,x_n\rangle$; average over several for stability.
$k(x,z)=\exp(-\gamma\|x-z\|^2)$, infinite-dimensional feature space; large $\gamma$ is local and prone to overfit.
